characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: A sturdy leather apron dyed deep brown with worn patches at the elbows and cuffs, cinched to her waist by a thick hemp belt holding a silver brass buckle. Underneath, she wears a plain linen shirt in muted cream, sleeves rolled up to mid‑bicep, paired with dark woolen trousers tucked into calf‑high leather boots polished from frequent use. A faded red scarf loosely drapes around her neck for warmth and style
